pick.headline: Hamas bombmaker Yahya Ayyash killed by booby-trapped phone
pick.summary: On 5 January 1996 Yahya Ayyash, the Hamas bombmaker known as 'the Engineer', was killed in Gaza when an explosive-laden mobile phone detonated as he took a call; Israel's Shin Bet was widely held responsible.
pick.significance: Ayyash had built the bombs for a wave of suicide attacks in Israel. His killing was followed by a deadly Hamas bombing campaign in February and March 1996 that reshaped Israeli politics.
